verdicts.why: Phalanx Covenant Part 1 (#67) already has Warlock allying with Beast, Forge and Sinister against the Phalanx, so the alliance starts at #67.
Tolerance Is Extinction Part 2 (#9) is where Beast and Forge build the collar; Jean only uses it in Part 3 (#10).

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#67
value.text: With the X-Men absorbed by the Phalanx, Sinister joins Beast, Forge and Warlock against it.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An unlikely ally against the Phalanx.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Sinister joins him against the Phalanx.

split.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#68
split.text: Sinister saves Beast from the Phalanx and helps him build the virus that destroys it.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An unlikely ally. Saves Beast from the Phalanx.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Sinister saves him from the Phalanx.

verdicts.why: The alliance against the Phalanx starts in Part 1 (#67), but the virus is built in Part 2 (#68). So the stage is split, with neutral #67 cards and the virus and rescue facts moved to #68.

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#20
value.text: Graydon tries to infect Beast with a mutant plague and infects himself instead.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The bigot who tries to infect Beast with a plague.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The mutant Graydon tries to infect.

split.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#23
split.text: Beast saved Graydon's life after the plague attack, but Graydon has Beast's love Carly kidnapped, and Beast storms his headquarters to save her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The bigot whose life Beast saves.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Saves Graydon's life, though Graydon hates him.

verdicts.why: Graydon's failed attempt to infect Beast is in Time Fugitives Part 1 (#20), but Beast only carries him out of the destroyed lab in Part 2 (#21), and the Carly kidnapping is in #23. The proposal drops the Carly facts, so they are split off. (Creed already targets Beast in #14.)

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#20
value.text: Bishop travels back in time to stop Apocalypse from releasing a plague that mutants will be blamed for.

split.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#66
split.text: Bishop frees the psychics Apocalypse holds captive at the Axis of Time.

verdicts.why: Bishop first goes after Apocalypse's plague in Time Fugitives Part 1 (#20), but he frees the captive psychics in Beyond Good and Evil Part 4 (#66). The proposal drops that fact, so it is split off.
In Night of the Sentinels Part 2 (#2), Trask is shown as Gyrich's secret ally building and stockpiling Sentinels. He is not in #1. The Master Mold half is carried by item 681.
In The Final Decision (#13), a Sentinel defies Trask, and Master Mold declares it will control humans too. Trask, shocked, tries to stop it and has to be rescued.

value.title: X-Men '97#5
value.text: Rogue reveals that she had a secret romance with Magneto when she was younger, since his power lets her touch him. She agrees to lead Genosha beside him.

split.title: X-Men '97#9
split.text: After Genosha falls, Rogue joins Magneto on his new mutant haven, Asteroid M.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Rogue's old flame, whose Asteroid M she joins.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The woman Magneto loves, who joins him on Asteroid M.

verdicts.why: Rogue reveals the secret past romance and agrees to lead Genosha with Magneto in Remember It (#5), but she joins him on Asteroid M in #9. The proposal drops that, so it is split off.
Captive Hearts (#5) shows Scott and Jean on a date when the Morlocks capture them, with Wolverine hurt by it. This is well before #43.
In Till Death Do Us Part Part 2 (#15), Sinister and his Nasty Boys kidnap Cyclops and Jean on their honeymoon. This is their first clash.
Morph is on the team from #1, and in #2 team leader Cyclops calls the retreat that leaves the seemingly dead Morph behind.
In #14, the reverend at Scott and Jean's wedding turns out to be Morph, who blames the X-Men for leaving him to die and, driven by Sinister, sets them against each other.
Cable shoots Gambit in the head, unleashing Apocalypse, in Survival of the Fittest (#19). A stage with no episode would spoil this.
Survival of the Fittest (#19): Apocalypse bursts out of Gambit and twists his body, and Rogue frees Gambit and traps Apocalypse's mind in a crystal.
In #19, Beast reveals that Nightcrawler offered his own life to Eson so Rogue and Gambit could be together. This is a clear turn after the #18 brainwashing.
In A Force to Be Reckoned With (#12), Cable recruits Jubilee to X-Force, and she is devastated when Archangel executes War on his orders.
The Motendo game and the kiss are in #4. The X-Force part moves to item 692, so nothing is lost.
In #12, Cable recruits Jubilee and Sunspot into X-Force and they track down War.
Both the mall attack and her capture by two Sentinels and Gyrich are in Night of the Sentinels Part 1 (#1). The Trask factory is only reached in #2.
In Mojovision (#24), Longshot quits Mojo over a contract dispute and forces Spiral to return the X-Men, and Mojo has to agree to his demands.
In Longshot (#36), he remembers betraying Mojo and leading a rebellion, and he goes back to see it through after the X-Men drive Mojo off.
In Fire Made Flesh (#3), the clone, now Madelyne, saves Nathan from Sinister and gives him to Bishop to find a cure. She recognizes the grown Cable in #5, which item 697 covers.
Remember It (#5): Cable arrives and Madelyne realizes he is an adult Nathan.
At the end of Bright Eyes (#7), Bastion reveals that Magneto, presumed dead at Genosha, is alive and his prisoner. Marvel Database lists Magneto as a cameo there, revealed alive.

value.title: X-Men '97#5
value.text: An upgraded Master Mold and an army of Sentinels massacre Genosha, Magneto's mutant nation.

verdicts.why: The Genosha massacre is in #5, not #8, but the attacker is an upgraded Master Mold with an army of Sentinels. Marvel Database's 'Wild Sentinel' is a label from the wiki that the summary never uses, so the text names Master Mold instead.
In Tolerance Is Extinction Part 1 (#8), a horrified Cooper releases Magneto as the Prime Sentinels attack. The arrest for trial is in #2 (item 701).
Mutant Liberation Begins (#2): UN forces led by Dr. Valerie Cooper try to arrest Magneto, and he surrenders to face trial.
In Sanctuary Part I (#48), Cortez tricks Magneto into an escape pod and launches him into space. Part II (#49) is Cortez running Asteroid M.
Magneto first appears in this arc in Part 2, 'Promise of Apocalypse' (#64), where Magda is mentioned and he takes Psylocke through a portal to the Axis. He turns on Apocalypse in Part 4 (#66).

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#40
value.text: Mastermind of the Inner Circle uses illusions to give Jean a false past and pull her into the Hellfire Club.

split.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#41
split.text: Mastermind tries to force Jean to kill Scott, and she breaks free of his control. His meddling helps turn the Phoenix inside her dark.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Breaks free when Mastermind tries to make her kill Scott.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Tries to make Jean kill Scott.

verdicts.why: Mastermind first appears in Dark Phoenix Part I (#40), creating Jean's false past. In Part II (#41) he tries to force her to kill Cyclops and she breaks free. The proposal drops the dark-Phoenix fact, so it is split to #41.
Sinister's hold on Morph starts in Till Death Do Us Part Part 1 (#14), where his voice urges Morph's revenge as Sinister watches. In #15 Sinister says he saved Morph. The freeing at #26 is item 706.
Reunion Part 2 (#26): Sinister tries to reassert control over Morph, Xavier removes the conditioning, and Morph fights with the X-Men.
Morph is struck down by a Sentinel and left behind during the Mutant Control Agency raid in Night of the Sentinels Part 2 (#2). The Courage half moves to item 708.
Courage (#51): Morph rejoins the team, faces the Sentinels that nearly killed him, overcomes his fear and destroys Master Mold.
Mystique is at the mansion sabotaging Cerebro during the train station attack, which is Magneto, Toad and Sabretooth. Her fight with Logan is at the Statue of Liberty.
The mid-credits scene of Survival of the Fittest (#19) has Mystique shooting Cooper and taking her identity. A stage with no episode spoils it.

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#20
value.text: In 3999, Cable and his men battle Apocalypse.

verdicts.why: In Time Fugitives Part 1 (#20), Cable and his men battle Apocalypse in 3999. Cable only travels back to the present in Part 2 (#21), so that clause is cut to avoid a one-episode spoiler.

value.title: X-Men '97#11
value.text: Apocalypse wants young Nathan as his next body. Grown into Cable, Nathan forms X-Force to stop him.

split.title: X-Men '97#19
split.text: Cable shoots Gambit to kill Apocalypse but unleashes him instead. Rogue traps Apocalypse's mind in a crystal and hands it to Cable.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The enemy Cable is destined to kill, now trapped in a crystal Cable holds.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Holds the crystal that traps Apocalypse's mind.

verdicts.why: In Days of Past Future (#11), Apocalypse's followers want Nathan as his vessel, and Cable starts X-Force. The crystal is given to Cable in #19. The proposal drops that fact, so it is split to #19.
Fire Made Flesh (#3): Sinister infects baby Nathan with a techno-organic virus and leaves him gravely ill.
In Slave Island (#7), Cable infiltrates Genosha's Sentinel factory and destroys many Sentinels.
In Rise of Apocalypse Part 2 (#14), Nur turns on the X-Men and becomes Apocalypse. Kurt's sacrifice is in #19 and moves to item 716.
Survival of the Fittest (#19): Beast reveals that Nightcrawler offered his own life to Eson so Rogue could live and be with Gambit.
X-Men: Apocalypse ends with Ororo turning on En Sabah Nur and fighting him alongside Lehnsherr and Scott, so the film leaves them as enemies.
In A Force to Be Reckoned With (#12), Polaris is on Cooper's X-Factor, capturing young mutants, and Jubilee convinces her to help her escape.
Xavier and Cyclops both first appear in Night of the Sentinels Part 1 (#1), where the X-Men act under Xavier's leadership.
